title: First bands: R.D. Jordan, Wally Mercy, Carl Davis, Harold Andrews and Charlie Broodin
summary: Ida names the Pensacola bands she worked in, starting with R.D. Jordan, then they talk about saxophonist Charlie Broodin.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
